components.name: Notebook toolbar
components.description: Single-row navigation, paper controls and a Lucide palette menu with visible ink-colour name on the left; icon-led save, new-page and presentation actions on the right.

components.name: Status footer
components.description: Full-width footer with a 56px minimum height and 16px horizontal / 10px vertical outer layout margins: notebook connection and reconnect, flexible operation result, last-sync storage estimate, live draft status and fit/zoom controls. Notes actions have 16px clearance above it. Hidden during presentation.

components.name: Search field
components.html: <input class="ds-search" placeholder="Search titles and transcripts" aria-label="Search notes">

components.name: Document row
components.description: Inset click-to-toggle multi-select row with title, date and transcript state; selection stays clear of the list boundary and scrollbar.
components.html:
Meeting notes
06 Oct 2026 · Not transcribed

narrative.overview: A restrained native workspace in warm paper and graphite. Saved documents lead; the live notebook becomes the focal object when sharing. Familiar controls, readable typography and contextual actions carry the product's richness.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces, precise hairlines and no decorative shadows.
Searchable document list beside a large vector preview.
Native font family with a compact, legible hierarchy.

rules.name: The Paper Before Paint Rule
rules.body: Use the established neutral palette before adding a hue.

dos: Do render documents as vectors and keep raw samples unchanged.
Do keep backend operations outside Qt widgets.
Do protect edits, drafts and existing exported files.
donts: Don't expose implementation jargon in everyday workflows.
Don't add decorative cards, gradients, glass or shadows.
Don't put device identifiers or logs into presentation mode.
